SchematicProject.title: SchematicProject
SchematicProject.description: A cloud-synced electronic schematic and PCB layout project with components, routed nets, and validation metrics.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the schematic owner.

gridSnapMm.description: Schematic/PCB snap grid spacing in millimeters (0.5-10).

components.description: List of placed electronic components on the schematic canvas (max 120).

wires.description: List of electrical net connections / PCB traces between component pins (max 300).

componentCount.description: Count of components in the schematic.

wireCount.description: Count of wires/traces in the schematic.

validationErrorCount.description: Current real-time ERC/DRC validation issue count.

validationSummary.description: Summary of the latest real-time electrical validation status.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the schematic was created (client submits FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the schematic was last synced (client submits FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/schematics/{schematicId}.description: User-owned PCB schematic projects synchronized in real time.
